pages.text: $(thing)Lootr$() makes every loot container in the world unique per player. Two people can open the same dungeon chest and each gets a full set of loot. No more racing for the first chest.

pages.title: Loot Chest
pages.text: Generated chests turn into these. Each player sees and empties only their own copy.

pages.title: Loot Barrel
pages.text: Barrels, shulkers and decorated pots in structures follow the same rule.

Containers you place yourself are normal. Only containers that would roll a vanilla loot table become Lootr ones, including those in $(l:exploration/structure_packs)structure packs$(/l), $(l:exploration/create_structures)Create structures$(/l) and $(l:ocean/underwater_places)undersea wrecks$(/l).

pages.title: Suspicious Sand
pages.text: Archaeology blocks are covered as well.
